summary: Iteration 15: Complete i18n (internationalization) feature testing. All 6 languages (ES, EN, FR, IT, ZH, JA) working correctly. Backend API tests: 14/14 passed. Frontend language switching, persistence, and translations admin page all functional.

backend_endpoints: POST /api/i18n/translations/bulk - updates multiple languages at once ✓
GET /api/i18n/user-language - returns language preference for authenticated user ✓
frontend_landing_page: Language selector (globe icon) visible in navbar ✓
Clicking English translates page to English ✓
Clicking French translates page to French ✓
Clicking Chinese translates page to Chinese ✓
Clicking Japanese translates page to Japanese ✓
Language persists in localStorage after refresh ✓
frontend_login_page: Language selector visible on login page ✓
Spanish text displayed correctly (Iniciar Sesion, Continuar con Google) ✓
English text displayed correctly (Log In, Continue with Google) ✓
frontend_translations_page: All 6 language tabs visible (ES, EN, FR, IT, ZH, JA) ✓
frontend_dashboard: Language selector visible in dashboard header ✓
Navigation items translated (Dashboard, Projects, Library, OOP Classes, Components) ✓
Stat cards translated (PROJECTS, DIAGRAMS, VERSIONS, OOP CLASSES) ✓
Japanese translations working (ダッシュボード, プロジェクト, etc.) ✓

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in /app/backend/routers/i18n.py: user-language endpoints were using db.sessions instead of db.user_sessions
I18nContext properly implements fallback chain: backend overrides > default translations > Spanish fallback
Language preference stored in both localStorage (app_lang key) and database (for authenticated users)
All 226+ translation keys properly defined for all 6 languages in translations.js
LanguageSelector component uses data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 verified complete i18n implementation. All 6 languages (Spanish, English, French, Italian, Chinese, Japanese) work correctly. Backend endpoints for translations CRUD and user language preference all functional. Frontend language selector in navbar, translations admin page at /translations, and language persistence in localStorage all working. Fixed bug where i18n router was using wrong session collection (db.sessions instead of db.user_sessions).

mocked_apis.note: All i18n endpoints are fully implemented and functional
